proposed_ledger_entry: Item 312 proves an exact all-s order-three, degree-seven recurrence for the Item-310 rational aggregate A_s by a rational hypergeometric telescoping certificate with all removable and terminal endpoints closed. The trailing and leading coefficients factor completely. Under the actual fixed-M relation 3p_s=4M+2s+1, every prime dividing a pivot divides one of two explicit nonzero degree-seven integers R_0(M),R_3(M), so singular-pivot logarithmic mass is O(log M)=o(M). This localizes only recurrence singularities, not collision primes p_s|D_s,epsilon. The positive comparison C_s=binomial(7s,s) has an order-one degree-seven recurrence and retains exact tied-prime mass M/38+o(M); hence bounded order/degree, integrality, nonvanishing, and exponential height alone cannot imply o(M). This is strictly an information-class no-go, not a claim about the actual sequence or exact operator. Booking is zero; W_D(M) remains open and the fixed-j=1 ceiling remains 1/36 per 6M.
